articles.title: Scientists Find 'Nightmare Fuel' Sea Spiders in the Salish Sea
articles.summary: Imagine a sea spider with hairy legs and bright red eyes. Scientists found two new kinds in the Salish Sea — the first in nearly 100 years! One has a mouth like a tiny monster pit.

articles.title: Dead Star Creates a Shock Wave That Shouldn't Exist
articles.summary: A dead star called RXJ0528+2838 is making a giant shock wave in space — but scientists say it shouldn't be able to. It's like a ship's wake without an engine!

articles.title: Scientists Burned Their Own Scrolls to Read Ancient Ones
articles.summary: To read 2,000-year-old burned scrolls, scientists made their own fake ones and set them on fire. They discovered that lead in the ink could reveal hidden writing!
